title: Retained Pair Equivalence Class Protocol
starting_point: V1696.1 showed that even aggregation-derived R_pair failed cross-scale transport. Therefore retained pair identity should not be assumed to be vector-transportable across scale.
claim_boundary: Protocol only. No execution, no compatibility claim, no retained field-law validation.

discarded_framing.reason: nearest-cell and aggregation-derived R_pair both failed killer nulls

new_object.name: retained pair equivalence class
new_object.definition: Two product pairs p and q are R-equivalent if they preserve the same retained product role under Phi_oplus response, orientation, support/provenance admissibility, and D1/D2 action profile.
new_object.not_a_vector: The equivalence class is not a transported vector and not a nearest coarse/fine cell match.
new_object.space: quotient of retained pair actions by role-preserving transformations

equivalence_requirements.E1_product_role: same product-role label, e.g. B0_B1, B1_B2, O3_B0, or declared role morphism
equivalence_requirements.E2_orientation: same signed provenance/orientation or admissible sign morphism
equivalence_requirements.E3_D1D2_profile: same derivative-response profile under Phi_oplus up to declared normalization
equivalence_requirements.E4_pair_Gram_relation: same signed pair-Gram relation to other retained roles in the local product algebra
equivalence_requirements.E6_order_ledger: same retained-order dependency class where available

coarse_graining_rule.aggregate_condition: coarse class exists only if fine classes form a compatible role-preserving family
coarse_graining_rule.failure_mode: if fine classes do not cohere, coarse pair identity is undefined rather than forced.

invariant.class_signature: Sig([p]_R) = (role, orientation, D1D2_profile, signed_Gram_context, support_class, order_class)
invariant.coherence_score: C_R(A) = consistency of fine class signatures inside coarse aggregate A
invariant.cross_scale_test: coarse class preservation means Sig([P_A^C]_R) matches quotient-aggregate Sig({[p_a^F]_R}) better than class-breaking nulls.
invariant.important: This tests equivalence-class preservation, not vector transport.

killer_nulls.N_role_preserved_vector_scrambled: preserve local vector norms but scramble product-role labels; must fail.
killer_nulls.N_D1D2_profile_scramble: preserve Gram signatures but scramble derivative-response profiles; must fail.
killer_nulls.N_orientation_flip: flip orientation signs while preserving magnitudes; must fail unless sign morphism declared.
killer_nulls.N_support_class_shuffle: preserve product pairs but shuffle support/provenance admissibility; must fail.
killer_nulls.N_local_signature_preserved_class_broken: preserve local pair-labeled invariants but break quotient aggregate compatibility; must fail.

promotion_rules.level_1: local retained pair classes separate class-breaking nulls
promotion_rules.level_2: coarse classes preserve quotient-aggregate signatures across scale and beat nulls
promotion_rules.not_allowed: No vector transport, D=rho+Q compatibility, or global law claim.
